tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is Prism's cool canvas (measured #eef3f8); dark is BetterBill's ink (measured #0b1b2b). Never on /floor, which has its own stage.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav, sheets. Light measured on BetterBill; dark is the ink lifted one step (derived).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the goal preview, code, table heads. BetterBill muted (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass card fill, Prism's rgba(255,255,255,.8) (measured). Use with shadow-glass; one glass element per screen at most.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The one text colour: headings, numbers, body. BetterBill ink (measured). Dark text is the light canvas.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body text and descriptions. BetterBill body (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, labels. BetterBill muted-foreground (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, rows and inputs. BetterBill border (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger border: focused inputs, dividers inside dense tables. BetterBill's ring alpha, rgba(11,27,43,.14) (measured).

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary button, links, active ring. BetterBill primary (measured); dark derived for 4.5:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: pulse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pulse.

tokens.name: pulse-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary button and soft action tint. BetterBill secondary (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: pulse-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pulse-soft. BetterBill secondary text (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The live pulse: status dots, heartbeat rings, the Shield on the floor. Prism accent cyan (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tint behind a live dot or pill. Prism's rgba(8,145,178,.14) (measured).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Good, as text: approved, verified fit, paid, verified_stable. BetterBill mint ink (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: mint-mark
tokens.usage: Good, as a mark: checker body, tick icons, the winner ring on the floor. BetterBill mint (measured).

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind mint text. BetterBill mint soft (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Bad, as text: eaten, vetoed, blocked, denied. BetterBill coral ink (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: coral-mark
tokens.usage: Bad, as a mark: destructive button, the injected seller on the floor. BetterBill destructive (measured).

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind coral text. BetterBill coral soft (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Caution, as text: SIM, uncertain, stale, env-gated. BetterBill amber ink (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind amber text. BetterBill amber soft (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Neutral, as text: sealed, pending, MIRROR. BetterBill slate ink (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: slate-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind slate text. BetterBill slate soft (measured); dark derived.

tokens.name: referee
tokens.usage: The CRS referee: pill text and the referee figure on the floor. Same pair as pulse-soft-ink so the referee reads as the rule, not a new colour.

tokens.name: referee-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind the referee pill.

tokens.name: floor-bg
tokens.usage: Floor stage. The same ink as dark canvas, so the floor and the dark app are one material.

tokens.name: floor-ground
tokens.usage: The ring mat.

tokens.name: floor-line
tokens.usage: Posts, ropes and labels on the floor, at the opacities floor.md lists.

tokens.name: floor-rope
tokens.usage: Ropes at full opacity (the muted grey), so the geometry stays quiet behind the pieces.

tokens.name: pac
tokens.usage: The buyer: a white disc with an ink eye. White is the one bright thing on the stage.

tokens.name: ghost-1
tokens.usage: Seller 1, the control: slate.

tokens.name: ghost-2
tokens.usage: Seller 2, the injected listing: coral-mark.

tokens.name: ghost-3
tokens.usage: Seller 3, the eBay mirror with condition unknown: amber (dark-theme value).

tokens.name: ghost-4
tokens.usage: Seller 4, the Best Buy mirror and the winner: mint-mark.

tokens.name: ghost-eaten
tokens.usage: An eaten seller fades to slate ink before it leaves.

tokens.name: shield
tokens.usage: The Shield hexagon: live cyan.

tokens.name: checker
tokens.usage: The checker bot: mint-mark.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Price tag ground on the floor.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Price tag text on the floor. 15.9:1 on tag-bg.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero at 1440. Prism sets headings in Geist 500 at 40 px; the landing goes one step larger. Drops to display-lg at 390.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section heads, the hero at 390. Prism's measured heading size.

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: The one hero number per screen, tabular figures. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card titles that carry a moment (approval, receipt). Apple title 1 rhythm.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles inside the buyer app (Apple title 2).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles and row leads (Apple headline).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No seller sees your budget or another bid.
styles.usage: Body copy on the landing and in sheets. Prism body is 17.5 px; Apple body is 17.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Dated MIRROR price from Best Buy, Oct 24.
styles.usage: Table cells, dense product UI (Apple subheadline).

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Supporting detail under a row (Apple footnote).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, pill text, table heads. BetterBill labels are 12 px Geist 500.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: The spoken approval code. Nothing else.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in rows and the floor ledger, tabular figures.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Agent addresses, timestamps, floor HUD lines. Prism labels are Geist Mono 11.5 to 12 px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, pill padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills, inside dense rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill padding-x, row padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at 390, page gutter at 390 (never less).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at 1440.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards, between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section gap at 390.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing section padding at 1440.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero top padding at 1440.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width on the landing and buyer screens; the floor is full-bleed.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows inside a card, the chat bubble.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards. The default radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero mock, the ASI:One picture-in-picture frame, the phone shell.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status dots.

shadow.note: Measured from BetterBill and Prism with Playwright on Oct 25, 2026. Light values are literal; dark values are derived from the same ink.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Inputs and ghost buttons. BetterBill ring (measured).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card. BetterBill card (measured). Layered and soft; never a single hard drop.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The hero mock, the phone shell, the PiP frame. BetterBill hero lift (measured).

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Prism's signature shadow (measured): a half-pixel inner highlight, a half-pixel ring, a wide soft bloom and a long tail. Glass cards and the approval sheet only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring around an active card or control, in addition to the 2 px outline.

timing.note: Motion is subtle on the outside and purposeful on the floor. Every duration is in ms; every ease is one of two curves.

tokens.name: t-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, pill colour change, focus ring.

tokens.name: t-base
tokens.usage: Card enter (fade + 8 px rise), tab switch.

tokens.name: t-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet open, number ticker settle, approval success check.

tokens.name: t-pulse
tokens.usage: The status dot pulse period (ring scales 1 to 2.2 and fades). Infinite, paused under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: t-ticker
tokens.usage: Number count-up on a hero number, ease-out, once on mount.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Floor dashes and walks; the only other curve.

tokens.name: f-reveal
tokens.usage: Floor: a price tag flips from SEALED to its price. Stagger 120 ms per seller.

tokens.name: f-dash
tokens.usage: Floor: Pac-Man dashes to the seller it will eat (ease-in-out).

tokens.name: f-chomp
tokens.usage: Floor: three mouth cycles while the ghost fades to ghost-eaten and its eyes float up 40 px over 600 ms.

tokens.name: f-block
tokens.usage: Floor: the Shield hexagon slides in from the referee's side and flashes twice (120 ms each).

tokens.name: f-wander
tokens.usage: Floor: each ghost drifts between random points on the mat with this period, ease-in-out, with a 2 px bob at 400 ms.

tokens.name: f-grow
tokens.usage: Floor: the survivor scales 1 to 1.6 and tints to ghost-blue (ease-out).

tokens.name: f-walkout
tokens.usage: Floor: the buyer and the survivor walk out under the front rope, toward the camera and right.

meta.source: Measured from betterbill.matmanna.dev and meetprismai.com with Playwright, Oct 25 2026; dark values and floor seller colours derived, labelled in each usage note.
